sources.observation: The west elevation has an ordered cream limestone arcade, dark basalt courses, red tiled roofs, and a tall domed clock tower at the south end.

limitations: The photographed elevations establish the roof and tower profile. Heights above the mapped eave and individual ornaments are estimates. The exterior covers the station building, with tracks and platform paving supplied by the host map.
